name: pflanzendex
description: PflanzenDex: Web-App für Pflanzensammler (Monorepo: core, api, web)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pflanzendex/api" "npm run dev -w @pflanzendex/web"
scripts.coverage: npm run test --workspaces --if-present -- --coverage && node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs" && node scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs
scripts.gates: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run boundaries && npm run specs && npm run format:check
scripts.ci: npm run gates && npm run coverage && npm run build
